title: VERIFICATION_GRADIENT — Witness Everything, Verify Contrast, Judge Exceptions

Immature systems verify actions; mature systems verify processes; civilizations verify exceptions; fleets scale only when verification moves upward through that gradient. Governing metric at scale: verification_cost_per_exception (per-transition metric must decay to ~0 or the human becomes the system clock). Receipt = WITNESS not verification (CCTV: exists unreviewed, existence changes behavior). Scarce resource = EXCEPTION ATTENTION. The opposite of verification is not trust; it is witnessing — verification consumes attention, witnessing preserves reality. TAC = allocation signal (intelligence at Expected!=Observed; zero-contrast verification cannot change decision per Law#5/P-DIAL). APEX = conversion engine (Phi ratchet: recurring exception -> scar -> policy -> routine; civilization is the sediment of resolved exceptions; laws are fossilized disputes). Void Guard: no-anomaly-observed != all-normal; witness layer itself must be an audited anomaly surface.

Fleet design target ~99.9% trusted witnessed transitions / 0.1% escalated exception judgment. arifFlow FQ is the tachometer: sustained BURNING = gradient violation. Per-class exception rate must decay over time or institutions are not metabolizing anomalies. Layer gradient reading: L4 witness-only, L3 policy+artifact, L2 audit, L1 live supervision, L0 exception judgment.

title: WIRE_DETECTOR_VENDOR_NEUTRALITY — a sovereignty detector shaped like one vendor's SDK is not a sovereignty detector; and a detector proven only on the negative case is unproven (may be dead code)
summary: The -001 detector hunted OpenAI literals only. Live probe of vendor SDK trees installed on KVM8 falsified that as sufficient: Anthropic ships a hosted agents SDK (anthropic/resources/beta/agents/agents.py -> client.beta.agents.create), and Google ships GAOS hosted agents (google/genai/_gaos/agents.py -> POST generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/agents with base_environment: 'remote', base_agent: 'antigravity-preview-05-2026'). An OpenAI-shaped detector stays GREEN while a genuine wire-yield through Anthropic or Google walks past it. Root error: the doctrine is about locus of the orchestration loop, but the detector was written about a brand. Detector widened to three vendors. THE MORE IMPORTANT LESSON: the first widened draft included bare 'base_agent:' as a signal. Dry-run against the real corpus (15,383 files) showed it false-HOLDs on AAA/agents/antigravity/agent.yaml — a legitimate LOCAL sovereign agent card registered in AGENTS_UNIFIED.yaml:121 with full constitutional floors and 'F13: harness switch belongs to sovereign'. base_agent is a model/harness identifier key, not a remote-environment declaration. The genuine hosted signal is base_environment: remote or the hosted endpoint. A detector that cries wolf on the sovereign's own agent card gets disabled, which is worse than no detector. Dry-run caught it before ship; shipping the loose pattern would have poisoned the nightly run. Two reusable invariants: (a) match the wire, never the label — naming-doctrine applied defensively, a name is not a capability; (b) a detector must be tested positive as well as negative, because a detector that only ever passes may simply be dead code.
operational_impact: aaa_drift_check.py §11 widened from 4 OpenAI-only patterns to 9 across OpenAI/Anthropic/Google, with explicit self-exclusion and a documented note on why bare base_agent must NOT be a signal. Lesson routed to ASI-drift-watch skill so it loads at detector-authoring time rather than sitting in always-on memory.
